name: Road to Salvation
summary: Hulfdan Blackbeard in Ironforge asks you to speak with him about the Hidden Circle. He tests whether you think yourself a scoundrel fit to join his chosen few.

sections.title: Hulfdan's Test
sections.body: Hulfdan Blackbeard in Ironforge wants to know whether you see yourself as a scoundrel. He is considering you for a place among the Hidden Circle's chosen few. His answer depends on how highly you think of yourself.

faq.q: Who is asking to speak with me?
faq.answer: Hulfdan Blackbeard in Ironforge asks you to speak with him.
The Hidden Circle is an organization with chosen members and officers. Hulfdan Blackbeard is looking for scoundrels to join its chosen few.

faq.q: Why does Hulfdan call me a scoundrel?
faq.answer: Hulfdan asks whether you think yourself a scoundrel fit to join the Hidden Circle's chosen few.

faq.q: What does Hulfdan want from me?
faq.answer: Hulfdan wants to speak with you about becoming one of the Hidden Circle's chosen few.

attribution: In-game quest text: Road to Salvation
